/opt/homebrew/bin/bash -lc '"$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response set "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json" --item must/016 --status unmet --source probe:env-spec-tracked+judgement --flag probe-overridden --drop-evidence --reason '"'The authorized hub route exposes no ref for this commit; a fresh clone cannot retrieve its 54 required participant maps from the annex remote.' --evidence '2026-10-16-remote-check.txt=only parent main and git-annex refs; target commit absent' --evidence '2026-10-16-fresh-rerun.json=54 map retrieval errors in a fresh local clone; no replay' --evidence 'README.md=annex route requires an accessible remote but gives no remote setup'

read -r checklist_url < "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-url.txt"
"$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response decode "$checklist_url" -o "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-decoded.json"
"$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" response validate "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json"
"$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_PYTHON" "$STAMPED_ASSESSMENT_RUNNER" validate "$STAMPED_JUDGE_OUTPUT/2026-10-16-response.json"
'
